name: NestWorks C500
notes: No live price: USD 2,799 (+ shipping) was the Kickstarter Standard package pledge (campaign ended Dec 2025, All-in-One USD 3,999; late pledges closed). The official site now shows 'Pre-Order', but its store is not open yet. Estimated MSRP USD 4,699. Working area 240 × 210 mm without ATC; with ATC 207 × 210 mm (X-ATC) or 240 × 160 mm (Y-ATC) per spec table (FAQ says 157 × 210 / 240 × 95 mm). Z travel 132 mm. Repeatability ±0.01 mm (spec table; FAQ ±0.008 mm). Drawbar spindle with RFID tool holders (1/8"-1/4" shanks, adaptive collets), 3D probe, tool setter, laser height sensor, 5 MP probing camera, MQL and auger chip evacuation, IP54. Optional 4th axis (Ø95 mm).
